production.note: US model years 2015-2023. Start: Dodge's 2015 Challenger specifications: 'ENGINE: 6.4-LITER HEMI® V-8 POWERED BY SRT / Availability Standard — R/T Scat Pack and 392 HEMI® Scat Pack Shaker (late availability)'. End: Dodge's 2023 specifications list the R/T Scat Pack (dodge-challenger-specs-2023), and Challenger production at Brampton ended on 22 December 2023 (gmauthority-brampton-end-2023).

body.note: Two-door coupe (inferred from the Challenger specification sheet). The Widebody is an option package.

aspiration.note: Inferred: no forced induction is mentioned for the 392 HEMI.

drivetrain.note: Inferred: the Challenger offered AWD only on V6 models (SXT AWD, GT AWD in the 2019 sheet); no R/T Scat Pack AWD is listed.

transmission.note: Six-speed manual: 'Standard — R/T models, T/A models, R/T Scat Pack, 392 HEMI Scat Pack Shaker, T/A 392 and SRT 392' (Tremec TR-6060). Eight-speed automatic: 'Available with 5.7-liter and 6.4-liter HEMI V-8 engine'. The 2023 sheet still lists both (dodge-challenger-specs-2023).

powerHp.note: Quote (Dodge 2018 specifications): "Power (SAE net) 485 bhp (362 kW) @ 6,100 rpm" for the 6.4-liter HEMI on the R/T Scat Pack. The 2017 sheet gives "485 bhp (362 kW) @ 6,100 rpm (75.8 bhp/liter)", "Standard — R/T Scat Pack, 392 HEMI Scat Pack Shaker, T/A 392 and SRT 392 models" (dodge-challenger-specs-2017), and the 2019 and 2023 sheets the same 485 bhp (dodge-challenger-specs-2019, dodge-challenger-specs-2023). The 2015 sheet gave 485 bhp @ 6,000 rpm (dodge-challenger-specs-2015), so the rating was 485 hp throughout.

weightLb.note: Standard body with the six-speed manual, 2018 model year. Quote (Dodge 2018 specifications, row 'Curb Weight'): "4,231 (1,919) — R/T Scat Pack (manual)"; automatic "4,235 (1,921)". The 2015 and 2017 sheets label their weights "Curb Weight (preliminary)" (2017: "4,232 (1,920) — R/T Scat Pack / 392 HEMI Scat Pack Shaker / T/A 392 (manual)", dodge-challenger-specs-2017) and no 2016 sheet could be opened, so the reference year is 2018, the first year with a final Dodge figure. Later Dodge figures for the manual: 2019 "4,234 (1,921)", 2023 "4,223 (1,915)" (Widebody 4,298 lb).

sources.title: Production Of Camaro Rival Dodge Challenger Ends Today

discrepancies.reason: Preliminary vs final: Dodge's 2017 sheet labels its weights preliminary; the 2018 sheet does not.
